passages.text: Now a man of the house of Levi married a daughter of Levi, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him for three months.
passages.sermon:
A man from the tribe of Levi took a wife.
His wife was also from the tribe of Levi.
The woman became pregnant.
She gave birth to a son.
She saw that her son was beautiful.
She hid her son for three months.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אִ֖ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית לֵוִ֑י וַיִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־ בַּת־ לֵוִֽי׃ וַתַּ֥הַר הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתֵּ֤רֶא אֹתוֹ֙ כִּי־ ט֣וֹב ה֔וּא וַֽתִּצְפְּנֵ֖הוּ שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יְרָחִֽים׃

passages.text: But when she could no longer hide him, she got him a papyrus basket and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in the basket and set it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.
passages.sermon:
A woman from the tribe of Levi gave birth to a son.
Pharaoh had commanded that every Hebrew boy must be thrown into the Nile.
The woman hid her son for three months.
She could not hide him any longer.
She took a basket made of papyrus.
She coated the basket with tar and pitch.
She placed her son inside the basket.
She set the basket among the reeds.
The reeds were along the bank of the Nile River.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ יָכְלָ֣ה עוֹד֮ הַצְּפִינוֹ֒ וַתִּֽקַּֽח־ לוֹ֙ תֵּ֣בַת גֹּ֔מֶא וַתַּחְמְרָ֥ה בַחֵמָ֖ר וּבַזָּ֑פֶת וַתָּ֤שֶׂם בָּהּ֙ אֶת־ הַיֶּ֔לֶד וַתָּ֥שֶׂם בַּסּ֖וּף עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃

passages.text: And his sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a baby boy from the tribe of Levi.
His mother placed him in a basket by the river.
His sister was a young Hebrew girl.
She stood far away from the basket.
She wanted to see what would happen to Moses.
passages.original: וַתֵּתַצַּ֥ב אֲחֹת֖וֹ מֵרָחֹ֑ק לְדֵעָ֕ה מַה־ יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Soon the daughter of Pharaoh went down to bathe in the Nile, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. And when she saw the basket among the reeds, she sent her maidservant to retrieve it.
passages.sermon:
The daughter of Pharaoh went down to the Nile.
She went there to bathe.
Her attendants walked along the riverbank.
She saw a basket among the reeds.
She sent her maidservant to get the basket.
The maidservant took the basket.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֤רֶד בַּת־ פַּרְעֹה֙ לִרְחֹ֣ץ עַל־ הַיְאֹ֔ר וְנַעֲרֹתֶ֥יהָ הֹלְכֹ֖ת עַל־ יַ֣ד הַיְאֹ֑ר וַתֵּ֤רֶא אֶת־ הַתֵּבָה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַסּ֔וּף וַתִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֶת־ אֲמָתָ֖הּ וַתִּקָּחֶֽהָ

passages.text: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the little boy was crying. So she had compassion on him and said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh’s daughter opened the basket.
She saw the child inside.
The little boy was crying.
Pharaoh’s daughter felt compassion for him.
She said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”
passages.original: וַתִּפְתַּח֙ וַתִּרְאֵ֣הוּ אֶת־ הַיֶּ֔לֶד וְהִנֵּה־ נַ֖עַר בֹּכֶ֑ה וַתַּחְמֹ֣ל עָלָ֔יו וַתֹּ֕אמֶר מִיַּלְדֵ֥י הָֽעִבְרִ֖ים זֶֽה׃

passages.text: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and call one of the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you?”
passages.sermon:
Moses was a Hebrew baby.
Pharaoh’s daughter found Moses in a basket by the river.
Moses’ sister was nearby.
Moses’ sister spoke to Pharaoh’s daughter.
She said, “Shall I go and call a woman?”
She meant a Hebrew woman.
She said, “She can nurse the child for you.”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֲחֹתוֹ֮ אֶל־ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹה֒ הַאֵלֵ֗ךְ וְקָרָ֤אתִי לָךְ֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה מֵינֶ֔קֶת מִ֖ן הָעִבְרִיֹּ֑ת וְתֵינִ֥ק לָ֖ךְ אֶת־ הַיָּֽלֶד׃

passages.text: “Go ahead,” Pharaoh’s daughter told her. And the girl went and called the boy’s mother.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh’s daughter spoke to the girl.
Pharaoh’s daughter said, “Go.”
The girl listened to Pharaoh’s daughter.
The girl went.
The girl called the boy’s mother.
passages.original: וַתֹּֽאמֶר־ לָ֥הּ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵ֑כִי וַתֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ הָֽעַלְמָ֔ה וַתִּקְרָ֖א אֶת־ אֵ֥ם הַיָּֽלֶד׃

passages.text: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and nurse him for me, and I will pay your wages.” So the woman took the boy and nursed him.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh’s daughter spoke to the woman.
Pharaoh’s daughter said, “Take this child.”
Pharaoh’s daughter said, “Nurse him for me.”
Pharaoh’s daughter said, “I will pay your wages.”
The woman took the boy.
The woman nursed the boy.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֧אמֶר לָ֣הּ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֗ה הֵילִ֜יכִי אֶת־ הַיֶּ֤לֶד הַזֶּה֙ וְהֵינִקִ֣הוּ לִ֔י וַאֲנִ֖י אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶת־ שְׂכָרֵ֑ךְ וַתִּקַּ֧ח הָאִשָּׁ֛ה הַיֶּ֖לֶד וַתְּנִיקֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: When the child had grown older, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses and explained, “I drew him out of the water.”
passages.sermon:
The child grew older.
His mother brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter.
Pharaoh’s daughter took the child as her son.
Pharaoh’s daughter named him Moses.
She said, “I drew him out of the water.”
passages.original: וַיִגְדַּ֣ל הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַתְּבִאֵ֙הוּ֙ לְבַת־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־ לָ֖הּ לְבֵ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַתֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י מִן־ הַמַּ֖יִם מְשִׁיתִֽהוּ׃

passages.text: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to his own people and observed their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a Hebrew child.
Pharaoh’s daughter adopted Moses as her son.
Moses grew up in Egypt.
One day, Moses had become an adult.
Moses went out to see his own people, the Hebrews.
Moses saw the Hebrews working very hard.
Moses saw an Egyptian man.
The Egyptian was beating a Hebrew man.
The Hebrew man was one of Moses’ own people.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֗ם וַיִּגְדַּ֤ל מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֶל־ אֶחָ֔יו וַיַּ֖רְא בְּסִבְלֹתָ֑ם וַיַּרְא֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י מַכֶּ֥ה אִישׁ־ עִבְרִ֖י מֵאֶחָֽיו׃

passages.text: After looking this way and that and seeing no one, he struck down the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a Hebrew man who grew up in Egypt.
He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew.
Moses looked around in every direction.
He saw that no one was there.
Moses struck the Egyptian.
He killed him.
Moses hid the Egyptian’s body in the sand.
passages.original: וַיִּ֤פֶן כֹּה֙ וָכֹ֔ה וַיַּ֖רְא כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַֽיִּטְמְנֵ֖הוּ בַּחֽוֹל׃

passages.text: The next day Moses went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, “Why are you attacking your companion?”
passages.sermon:
Moses was a Hebrew man who grew up in Egypt.
The next day, Moses went out.
He saw two Hebrew men.
They were fighting each other.
Moses spoke to the man who was doing wrong.
He said, "Why are you attacking your companion?"
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְהִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנֵֽי־ אֲנָשִׁ֥ים עִבְרִ֖ים נִצִּ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לָֽרָשָׁ֔ע לָ֥מָּה תַכֶּ֖ה רֵעֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: But the man replied, “Who made you ruler and judge over us? Are you planning to kill me as you killed the Egyptian?” Then Moses was afraid and thought, “This thing I have done has surely become known.”
passages.sermon:
A Hebrew man spoke to Moses.
He said, “Who made you ruler over us?”
He said, “Who made you judge over us?”
He asked Moses, “Do you want to kill me?”
He said, “Will you kill me as you killed the Egyptian?”
Moses became afraid.
Moses thought, “People know what I did.”
passages.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר מִ֣י שָֽׂמְךָ֞ לְאִ֨ישׁ שַׂ֤ר וְשֹׁפֵט֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ הַלְהָרְגֵ֙נִי֙ אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרַ֖גְתָּ אֶת־ הַמִּצְרִ֑י וַיִּירָ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר אָכֵ֖ן נוֹדַ֥ע הַדָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: When Pharaoh heard about this matter, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh and settled in the land of Midian, where he sat down beside a well.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh heard about what Moses had done.
Pharaoh wanted to kill Moses.
Moses ran away from Pharaoh.
Moses left Egypt.
Moses went to the land of Midian.
Moses stayed in Midian.
Moses sat down beside a well.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לַהֲרֹ֣ג אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּבְרַ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִדְיָ֖ן וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב עַֽל־ הַבְּאֵֽר׃

passages.text: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
passages.sermon:
The priest of Midian had seven daughters.
These daughters came to the well.
They drew water from the well.
They filled the troughs with water.
They did this to water their father's flock.
passages.original: וּלְכֹהֵ֥ן מִדְיָ֖ן שֶׁ֣בַע בָּנ֑וֹת וַתָּבֹ֣אנָה וַתִּדְלֶ֗נָה וַתְּמַלֶּ֙אנָה֙ אֶת־ הָ֣רְהָטִ֔ים לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת צֹ֥אן אֲבִיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: And when some shepherds came along and drove them away, Moses rose up to help them and watered their flock.
passages.sermon:
Some shepherds came.
The shepherds drove the seven daughters of the priest of Midian away.
Moses saw this.
Moses stood up.
Moses helped the daughters.
Moses watered their flock.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ הָרֹעִ֖ים וַיְגָרְשׁ֑וּם וַיָּ֤קָם מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיּ֣וֹשִׁעָ֔ן וַיַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־ צֹאנָֽם׃

passages.text: When the daughters returned to their father Reuel, he asked them, “Why have you returned so early today?”
passages.sermon:
Reuel was the father of the seven daughters.
The daughters returned to Reuel.
Reuel spoke to his daughters.
He asked them a question.
He said, "Why have you returned so early today?"
passages.original: וַתָּבֹ֕אנָה אֶל־ רְעוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִיהֶ֑ן וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַדּ֛וּעַ מִהַרְתֶּ֥ן בֹּ֖א הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: “An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds,” they replied. “He even drew water for us and watered the flock.”
passages.sermon:
The daughters of Reuel spoke to their father.
They said, “An Egyptian man rescued us from the shepherds.”
He saved us from their hands.
He drew water for us.
He gave water to our flock.
passages.original: וַתֹּאמַ֕רְןָ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י הִצִּילָ֖נוּ מִיַּ֣ד הָרֹעִ֑ים וְגַם־ דָּלֹ֤ה דָלָה֙ לָ֔נוּ וַיַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־ הַצֹּֽאן׃

passages.text: “So where is he?” their father asked. “Why did you leave the man behind? Invite him to have something to eat.”
passages.sermon:
Reuel was the father of the daughters.
Reuel spoke to his daughters.
He asked, “Where is the man?”
He said, “Why did you leave the man?”
He told them, “Call him.”
He said, “Let him eat bread.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ בְּנֹתָ֖יו וְאַיּ֑וֹ לָ֤מָּה זֶּה֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ן אֶת־ הָאִ֔ישׁ קִרְאֶ֥ן ל֖וֹ וְיֹ֥אכַל לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: Moses agreed to stay with the man, and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a Hebrew man.
Moses had fled from Egypt.
Moses agreed to live with the man named Reuel.
Reuel was the father of several daughters.
Reuel gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses as a wife.
passages.original: וַיּ֥וֹאֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אֶת־ הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיִּתֵּ֛ן אֶת־ צִפֹּרָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְמֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: And she gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, “I have become a foreigner in a foreign land.”
passages.sermon:
Moses was living in a foreign land.
His wife gave birth to a son.
Moses named his son Gershom.
Moses said, “I have become a foreigner in a foreign land.”
passages.original: וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ גֵּרְשֹׁ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר גֵּ֣ר הָיִ֔יתִי בְּאֶ֖רֶץ נָכְרִיָּֽה׃פ

passages.text: After a long time, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were slaves in Egypt.
They suffered under hard labor.
A long time passed.
The king of Egypt died.
The Israelites groaned because of their suffering.
They cried out for help.
Their cry for deliverance went up to God.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַיָּמִ֨ים הָֽרַבִּ֜ים הָהֵ֗ם וַיָּ֙מָת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֵּאָנְח֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִן־ הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה וַיִּזְעָ֑קוּ וַתַּ֧עַל שַׁוְעָתָ֛ם אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן־ הָעֲבֹדָֽה׃

passages.text: So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
passages.sermon:
God heard the Israelites groaning.
God remembered His covenant.
God made this covenant with Abraham.
God made this covenant with Isaac.
God made this covenant with Jacob.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ נַאֲקָתָ֑ם וַיִּזְכֹּ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ בְּרִית֔וֹ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־ יִצְחָ֥ק וְאֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: God saw the Israelites and took notice.
passages.sermon: God saw the Israelites.\r\nGod noticed them.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֖דַע אֱלֹהִֽים׃ס
